_about: Patterns: player-made items. Pick a frame, pick a tier, fill the slots. Sketch (free) -> Prototype (one downtime action, a roll) -> Proven (used in a scene, or a Striker field-tests it). Numbers follow First Edition v1.52 Weapon & Armor Quality, Properties, Armor profiles and Gear prices; the caps are what keep it from going OP. Spec: claude/CRAFTING_PATTERNS.md v0.2, cleared with Nib. Prices marked draft are not in the book.

1.name: Handyman
1.text: Homemade, sewer-built. Cheap and available. Backfire on a complete failure.

2.name: Crafted
2.text: Competent work from poor parts. Jams on a complete failure.

3.name: Common
3.text: Proper factory grade. No bonus, no penalty.

4.name: Specialized
4.text: Custom work. One improvement built in. One of the parts must be Chrome or Ember.

5.name: New Halo
5.text: Corp and deep-pockets gear. Not player-made: bought, stolen or issued. A player can Gear Mod one, never build one.

light-weapon.name: Light weapon
light-weapon.text: Max one step per hit. Concealable, Quick Draw, attack without spending Move.

standard-weapon.name: Standard weapon
standard-weapon.text: One step per excess success. Reliable, Versatile.

heavy-weapon.name: Heavy weapon
heavy-weapon.penalty: Presence: drawing it forces Root checks
heavy-weapon.text: Min one step on hit; excess pushes two. Suppressing, Presence.

tool.name: Tool
tool.text: +1 die on one named skill, or makes a roll possible. Item dice never stack.

variants.name: Signal jammer
variants.enables: Blocks electronic communication in Close range for one scene

consumable.name: Consumable
consumable.text: One effect per use, 1-3 uses. Heals at most one Wound step per use.

variants.name: Stimpack
variants.effectText: Ignore Wound penalties for one scene; crash afterward

charm.name: Charm
charm.text: A minor working stored in an object. Does what the working says, nothing more.

variants.name: Alarm charm
variants.effectText: You know when something crosses it

variants.name: Ward token
variants.effectText: One Minor warding for one scene

drone.name: Drone
drone.text: One job: scout, carry, distract or record. Fragile.

bag.name: Bag
bag.text: Inventory slots, using the sheet's Back slot rules.

variants.name: Broadcast kit
variants.enables: Transmits to a channel you can reach

papers.name: Papers
papers.text: Passes a check of a stated depth.

ap1.name: AP 1
ap1.text: Armor-piercing 1. The cap on player-made gear.

reliable.name: Reliable
reliable.text: Never Backfire or Unreliable; ignores the failure table. Removes a built-in Backfire or Unreliable.

concealable.name: Concealable
concealable.text: Passes a casual search; drawn without telegraphing.

versatile.name: Versatile
versatile.text: Works in more than one mode or range band.

remove-penalty.name: Remove a penalty
remove-penalty.text: Removes the frame's book penalty tag.

quiet.name: Quiet
quiet.text: Not Loud; can't be heard past Close range.

extra-use.name: +1 use
extra-use.text: One more use, up to the cap of 3.

second-skill.name: Second skill
second-skill.text: The +1 die also applies to a second, related skill.

sturdy.name: Sturdy
sturdy.text: Survives the first Break; repairable instead of lost.

signal-proof.name: Signal-proof
signal-proof.text: Ignores jamming for one scene per session.

energy1.name: Energy 1
energy1.text: Tier 5 corp gear only (or heavy armor by ruling).

loud.name: Loud
loud.text: Using it generates Heat or attention.

traceable.name: Traceable
traceable.text: Use can be tied back to you.

unreliable.name: Unreliable
unreliable.text: Jams on a complete failure; an Action to clear.

backfire.name: Backfire
backfire.text: Handyman Failure table on a complete failure.

fragile.name: Fragile
fragile.text: Breaks on any failed roll, not just a complete failure.

ugly.name: Ugly
ugly.text: Reads as Scrapfields work. -1 die on Persuade in corporate or high-status spaces while it's visible.

hungry.name: Hungry
hungry.text: 1 part or 20 cr a week, or it stops working until fed.

sizzle.name: Sizzle
sizzle.text: Near chrome or live tech, 1-in-6 something malfunctions.

weather-bit.name: Weather-bit
weather-bit.text: Stops working in rain, cold or deep tunnels (pick one).

tell.name: Tell
tell.text: Anyone who knows the Pattern recognizes it on sight.

text: No item ever removes a roll or guarantees a success.
No item does what a class Owns: no invisibility, no mid-scene ally repair beyond medkit rules, no real casting at scale.
Item dice never stack: on any roll only the best single item counts.
The sheet's slot rules hold: one active, one secondary, one armor, one back.

scrap.name: Scrap
scrap.text: Salvage in the Scrapfields, Greasewick Row, anywhere broken.

wire.name: Wire
wire.text: Salvage in the Tangle, Three Wires, the Sewers.

chem.name: Chem
chem.text: Dockside, Old City, The Ashrun; Slimefolk contacts.

ink.name: Ink
ink.text: Low Halo, Market Ring; anyone with paper.

chrome.name: Chrome
chrome.text: Salvage chrome off dead tech; Rust Market; Helix leftovers (careful).

corp.name: Corp-grade
corp.text: Not salvage. Bought at Restricted acquisition, stolen, or earned from a corp job. Worth a lot to a fence.

salvage.text: A Salvage roll in the right district: Routine for one part, each extra success one more. One try per district per Adyta day.

market.text: Rust Market, Low Halo. Parts at list price; you have to be there.

runnerSourcing.text: Runners: one free part per Delivery Run that touches Greasewick Row, the Scrapfields or the Sewers.

classRoles.Wrench: Designs weapons, armor, tools, drones and consumables. Gear Mod upgrades an item one tier.
classRoles.Shade: Designs charms. Reads a Pattern: learns its quirks, hidden ones included.
classRoles.Signal: Designs media. Talks a Pattern up or down on the air (Word).
classRoles.Ghost: Designs papers. Scrubs maker marks and trade codes.
classRoles.Runner: Designs bags and route gear. Sources one free part per run through the salvage districts.
classRoles.Striker: Field-tests a Prototype into Proven: one downtime action, no roll.
classRoles.Broker: Licenses a Pattern: sells someone the right to make copies; the maker gets a cut.
classRoles.Warden: Certifies a Pattern: it becomes Documented, and street sales of it in watched districts cost no Heat.

license.text: A license code lets its holder (with the right class) prototype a Proven Pattern. Each copy made under license sends the maker's cut back by the honor of the books: the PDA records it; the credits move by hand.
